articleTitle: Fake news detection using naive Bayes classifier
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper shows a simple approach for fake news detection using naive Bayes classifier. This approach was implemented as a software system and tested against a data set of Facebook news posts. We achieved classification accuracy of approximately 74% on the test set which is a decent result considering the relative simplicity of the model. This results may be improved in several ways, that are described in the article as well. Received results suggest, that fake news detection problem can be addressed with artificial intelligence methods.

articleTitle: Innovative technologies in laboratory workshop for students of technical specialties
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: It is shown that virtual laboratory complexes identical to real physical stands may provide an alternative in laboratory workshop for students of technical specialties of higher educational establishments. The basic requirements for virtual complexes are formulated and graphic programming medium LabVIEW is proposed as a platform for their creation. An example of a virtual laboratory complex for the students of electrical engineering specialties is analyzed. It was used in an experiment that assessed the virtual complex influence on the process of student practical training. Efficiency of the use of virtual laboratory complexes in training specialists is proved on the grounds of the data statistical processing.

articleTitle: Single-frame image super-resolution based on singular square matrix operator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In the paper the method of single-frame image super-resolution based on the singular decomposition of matrix operator of the convergence square matrix operator is proposed. The characteristic vectors-features are obtained by using the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse of matrix operator, which are used for enlarged image synthesis. The series of computational experiments based on images with fluctuation of intensity function are performed. The comparison results with others methods have confirmed the effectiveness of developed approach. The main advantages of proposed method for different enlargement coefficients are considered.

articleTitle: Investigation and simulation of system for data flow processing in multiservice nodes using virtualization mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper we propose a mathematical model of the functioning of network device with virtual routers. This model allows to decrease the mutual influence of the parametric effects of different types of traffic in the network node, as well as to estimate the quality of service by decomposition of a structure of network node and mathematical modeling based on queueing theory. To verify the proposed solutions we developed a structural and functional model of network device with dynamic virtualization of computing resources. This model allows to describe the process of router virtualization with optimization of specified level of QoS parameters for specific types of services.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis of power frequency electromagnetic field in buildings closed to overhead lines
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper studies the ability of a reinforced concrete building to shield the overhead line electromagnetic field. For this purpose the overhead line electromagnetic field is determined in a free space as well as in a building. The electromagnetic field calculation in a free space is carried out analytically. The electromagnetic field distribution in the building is determined by numerical simulation. It is shown that the overhead line magnetic field penetrates inside the building almost with no attenuation, because of poorly shielding by building elements. By contrast the overhead line electric field is effectively shielded by building elements, so it almost doesn't penetrate inside.

articleTitle: Improved method of group decision making in expert systems based on competitive agents selection
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problem of group decision making performed during selection of the best solution from possible alternatives in expert systems set was solved. The problem solution based on the integrated method, which consists of individual and group evaluation, increases quality of decision-making during expert evaluation process. The improved method of extraction and formalization of individual expert evaluations was proposed. The method is based on the analytic hierarchy process modification and includes absolute and relative evaluation phases. It evaluates expert competence based on confidence coefficient for expert judgments. Therefore, it is possible to evaluate confidence for expert judgments during individual evaluation process without additional time demands. The modified method of agent group evaluation based on summation of individual expert evaluations of every alternative was proposed. The method makes total evaluation based on relative quantitative importance of the agents and confidence coefficients for judgments of every group participant. It gives preference to judgments of qualified experts to increase solution quality.

articleTitle: Development of the method for determining the number of direct lightning strikes in overhead lines with protected wires
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The methods of determining the number of direct lightning strikes in overhead lines with protected wires. The calculation of the number of direct lightning strikes in overhead lines. Experimental study on a large-scale model of supporting change in the number of direct lightning strikes in overhead lines, depending on the type of wire. Identified lightning capture zone of overhead lines for medium voltage lines classes.

articleTitle: Heat transfer limitations of heat pipes for a cooling systems of electronic components
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Heat pipes are highly effective heat transfer devices for electronic components cooling systems. In the present paper, calculation results of a maximum heat flux are shown for temperature value 60 °C. Calculation was made for heat pipes, which are used for LED cooling, with axially grooved and with metal fibred capillary structures. Main heat transfer limitation for grooved heat pipes is boiling limit for ammonia coolant and entrainment limit for R141b. As for heat pipes with metal fibred capillary structure, the main heat transfer limitation is the capillary limit for water, ethanol and R141b. Wherein, increasing of porosity higher than 60% leads to replacing of capillary limit by boiling limit for all researched coolants.

articleTitle: Application perfected wave tracing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Vectorization is happened by a wave method. The wave method is to analyze the path of the way to the spherical wave in the image. At every step is analyzed offset center of point's mass forming a new step wave relative to the previous position of the center of mass. Offered of the perfected wave tracing algorithm is to use a spherical wave on the combined raster image while creating skeleton. The feature of skeletezationon prints, where deposited security elements in the form guilloché, is that almost no curves intersect. This avoids skeletezation of connection segments.

articleTitle: Impact of SAR data filtering on crop classification accuracy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: For many applied problems in agricultural monitoring and food security, it is important to provide reliable crop classification maps. In this paper, we aim to compare performance of different filters available in ESA SNAP toolbox and compare them with our approach with applying to reduce speckle in multitemporal synthetic-aperture radar (SAR) Sentinel-1 imagery. For this, we evaluate an impact of SAR data filtering on crop classification accuracy. We have found that overall classification accuracy without any filtering is 82.6% whilst the use of different despeckling methods achieves gain of crop map accuracy from +3.2% to +5.1% compared to classification of original data. The most accurate crop map has been obtained for SAR images pre-processed by DCT-based filter.

articleTitle: Smart road as a complex system of electric power generation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In the framework of the article road paving panels for “Smart Roads” system have been developed and calculated with an analyzed amount of generated and consumed electric energy. Modern road is currently to be taken as a separate part of construction as well as a bright and integral part of entire architectural ensemble of the surrounding area. One of the main requirements for modern roads is that they have to be fully self-maintained and operate as alternative and decentralized energy sources as well. The paper presents a design of the road paving panel for “Smart Roads” system and reveals the principle of its function. The amount of electricity generated per unit of road surface has been calculated. It is shown that for their own needs road paving panel will consume up to 71.25% of the total energy generated.

articleTitle: Detecting outliers in multivariate non-Gaussian data on the basis of normalizing transformations
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The statistical technique for detecting outliers in multivariate non-Gaussian data on the basis of normalizing transformations and the Mahalanobis squared distance (MSD) is proposed. Application of the technique is considered for detecting outliers in the data of four-variate measurements.

articleTitle: Bidirectional isolated ZVS DC-DC converter with auxiliary active switch for high-power energy storage applications
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper describes topology and control algorithm of a bidirectional isolated converter with controlled semiconductors at the voltage-fed and current-fed parts. A bidirectional switch connected in series with the transformer winding at the current-fed side features zero-current switching and allows achieving zero-voltage-switching of transistors at the voltage-fed side by utilising leakage inductance of the isolated transformer. The topology is proposed for high power battery or fuel cell systems. The proposed ideas are verified with simulations in MATLAB and evaluation prototype.

articleTitle: Real-time system for indoor user localization and navigation using bluetooth beacons
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Real-time user positioning and navigation services are widely used daily by millions of people. The challenge is that common global positioning systems fail in indoor environment or in scenes with a limited sky view. In the paper, the indoor navigation framework based on the Bluetooth beacons is proposed. Such system allows user to obtain the position in GPS denied environment on a real-time basis. Key steps for precise localizing and main components of the developed framework are considered. Initial experimental results are provided.

articleTitle: Development of hybrid solar generating module for high-efficiency solar energy station
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Experimentally established, the influence of the working temperature and solar radiation power on the efficiency of industrial production silicon solar cells. Based on the experimental results designed the concept of a hybrid solar generating module equipped with a mirror concentrator of solar radiation and solar cells cooling system for using in high-performance solar energy station. Concentrator of solar radiation provides in 1.5-time increase of electrical power generating by such module, and water-cooling system can reduce the equilibrium temperature of the module up to 10 degrees and twice reduce efficiency losses from solar cells overheating. The proposed concept will reduce the number of modules needed to build solar energy station.

articleTitle: Characteristic of capacitive sensor for the air gap control system in the hydrogenerator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper was proposed a capacitive sensor with coplanar parallel electrodes for measure the air gap between the stator and rotor in the hydrogenerators. The effects of influence of some technological errors on accuracy of measurement purposed capacitive air gap sensor has been analyzed. The design scheme and analytical dependences for the error identification because of inclination of sensor electrodes plane relatively to the pole surface of the rotor have been created. The additive error of measurement of air gap caused by the influence of curvature of the surface of the stator core bore has been calculated. Recommendations to minimize the influence of technological error on accuracy of measuring the air gap in the hydro generator have been developed.

articleTitle: Determination of low hemoglobin level in human using the analysis of symbolic dynamics of the heart rate variability
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Symbolic dynamics of electrocardiograms (ECG) carries the information about functioning of various human body systems. A method for distinguishing the men with low hemoglobin value from the men with normal hemoglobin value by analyzing the symbolic dynamics of the heart rate variability was proposed in the research. The method has got an acceptable sensitivity (0.67-0.80) and specificity (0.80-1.00) and works by using a single lead ECG.

articleTitle: Analysis of the impact of nonlinear distortion in voltage and current curves on the errors of electric energy metering devices
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This article deals with the problems of electricity metering under non-sinusoidal loads that consume non-sinusoidal currents from network and/or generate distortions into the network. The equations for determination of estimated values of active and reactive electric energy under the presence of higher harmonics are deduced. It is shown and experimentally confirmed that the meters of active and reactive power have unaccounted inaccuracies, which can exceed allowable metrological ranges. Frequency characteristics of some meters, used in the power grids of the Slovak Republic, are received, and they confirm the conducted theoretical studying.

articleTitle: Comparison of different types of electromechanical systems for creating the counter-rotating VAWT
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article presents a comparison by computer simulation the work of dual-rotor vertical axis wind turbine (VAWT) with three types of mechanical transmissions: rigid with the bevel gearbox, semi-rigid with the differential, and soft gearless with the double rotor synchronous generator with permanent magnets. The results of the study have shown the advantages and disadvantages of dual-rotor VAWTs with these transmissions on their start and operation in real conditions that can be characterized by different values WTs moments of inertia and wind gusts at different speeds acting on each of wind turbines (WT). The existence of the backlashes between the gears in rigid and semi-rigid mechanical transmissions causes significant ripples of elastic torques, which are larger in transmission with differential than in gear transmission. This drawback is absent in gearless transmission, making it the most promising to the application in small counter-rotation VAWTs.

articleTitle: Interleaved single-phase quasi-Z-source inverter with special modulation technique
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel topology based on the interleaved H-bridge qZS inverters that is intended for the single-phase photovoltaic systems. The potential benefits are the reduced passive components and improved quality of energy generation. To control the novel topology, a proper modulation technique was developed with the required phase-shifted carriers signals and shoot-through states.

articleTitle: A software phase-locked loop of control system of a series-resonant voltage-source inverter for induction heating equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Using a pulse density modulation (PDM) to regulate a load current of a resonant voltage-source inverter causes fluctuation of a current amplitude. The paper proposes a software phase-locked loop (SPLL) of control system in a resonant voltage inverter with PDM for induction heating equipment. The proposed SPLL changes a dead-time between control pulses of inverter transistors, taking into account current amplitude changes at the inverter output under PDM to provide a phase shift between its output voltage and current, which ensures lower dynamic power loss in these transistors. The paper presents results of experimental investigation of the proposed SPLL.

articleTitle: The prevention measure of resonance overvoltges in extra high voltage transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A rapid estimation of resonant overvoltages has been developed on basis of analysis of resonant circuit of the disconnected phase on extra high voltage transmission line. The influence of mutual induction caused by the design features of the three-phase shunt reactor group on overvoltages has been taken into account. A simulation model of the power transmission line has been developed to simulate electromagnetic transient processes in the incomplete phase mode. In response to the developed model and rapid assessment, a comparison of the effectiveness of the most common measures to prevent resonance overvoltages has been made. For calculation, the data of a real high-voltage power transmission line of a rated voltage of 750 kV was taken.

articleTitle: Diffraction of H-polarized electromagnetic wave by pre-fractal system of slots in PEC screen
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The process of plane H-polarized electromagnetic wave interaction with pre fractal system of slots in infinitely thing flat PEC screen is examined on the base of strong electromagnetic theory. Some stage of a self similar fractal's creation is used for the system's mathematical order. The diffraction problem is treated in the classically rigorous formulation on the base of the integral equation technique. Asymptotic model of narrow slots, which has an explicit solution, is analysed in details. On the base of the asymptotic model, two main integral characteristics were considered.

articleTitle: Investigation the maximal values of flux and stator current of autonomous induction generator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper deals with the investigation of flux and stator current maximal values of autonomous induction generator with DC link voltage and rotor angular speed below the rated values. The dependence of the maximum flux from DC link voltage is analytically determined based on the stator circuit electrical equilibrium equations in a steady state. The maximum value of the stator current active component is determined by the balance of power in autonomous generator. The simulation results of excitation processes of the generator and the charge of capacitor in the DC link confirmed the results of analytical studies. Presented results can be used in the design of startup algorithms of autonomous generation systems based on induction machines.

articleTitle: The specificity of electrical energy storage unit application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper, it is determined the need to use battery-based energy storage systems to improve the efficiency of energy supply systems and the quality of electrical energy. The requirements for energy storage devices are considered and the methodic of the parameters determination is given. The approach to the expansion of the frequency range of effective work of battery-based energy storage systems is proposed. The properties of the Battery Management System are overviewed. The operating parameters of the AMP20M1HD-A battery was obtained. Battery research was carried out with the use of test bench.

articleTitle: Availability assessment of a telecommunications system with permanent and intermittent faults
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper presents a mathematical model for assessing the availability of a non-redundant telecommunications system, which is continuously tested during operation. The types of faults that can occur in such systems are defined as permanent and intermittent faults. Mathematical equations are derived to calculate the mean times spent by the system in the operable and repair states using the properties of the regenerative process. The availability expression is derived under arbitrary fault distributions. Numerical example illustrates the impact of the faults rate on the system availability under exponential distribution of faults.

articleTitle: Joint innovative double degree master program «energy-saving technologies in transport»
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper encourages the development of energy-saving technologies and the improvement of environmental safety of road transport. Expected results: the joint educational program for master's degree of project related speciality has been created and is ready for the implementation; curricular/syllabi, training courses, methodical and teaching materials have been developed; retraining and advanced training UA teaching staff of universities - participants of the consortium have been completed, the improvement of the quality of educational services in UA universities, as well as the enlargement of interuniversity cooperation in the design and development of environmentally friendly road transport have been carried out; the educational Web site has been created and launched; the joint educational, methodical and scientific materials and project related results have been published.

articleTitle: Operation possibility of grid connected Quasi-Z-Source Inverter with energy storage and renewable energy generation in wide power range
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In renewable energy generation systems, energy storage is needed not only for short-term smoothening of the electric supply, but also to supply power when there is no generation for a longer period of time. The Quasi-Z-Source Inverter (qZSI) enables the integration of energy storage easily in addition to the other energy source mainly used for output power smoothening. In this paper the possibility to integrate energy storage in qZSI structure is analyzed in case when the input voltage is low or when battery is the only source of energy. The operation limits of the converter and possible solutions to extend the operation range are analyzed theoretically and by means of simulations in PSIM software. Results show that low input voltage limits the operation range of energy stored qZSI; modified circuits that can be used to avoid these limitations are proposed.

articleTitle: The use of Kotelnikov-Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem for designing of digital control system for a power converter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Transferring the known signal processing solutions from the field of communication to the field of digital control systems for electric power converter (inverters, active filters, etc.) developers are facing a number of challenges. These include problems with the identification of signals with a maximum frequency in accordance with the Kotelnikov-Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem. This article discusses the limitations imposed on the use of boundary conditions of this theorem applied to development of digital control systems for power converters that eliminate these problems.

articleTitle: Research of the interrelationship between the frequency converter on the basis of the resonant inverter with nonlinear control power unit parameters and its load
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Relationships between the desired load characteristics and parameters of the elements of the power unit of the frequency converter on the basis of the resonant inverter with nonlinear control were studied. Analytical dependences of these parameters on the specified load characteristics were received. Static and dynamic characteristics of the frequency converter with the parameters, computed in accordance to the received analytical dependences were plotted and investigated.

articleTitle: Model predictive control of photovoltaic bidirectional DC-DC converter with coupled inductors
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper describes a model predictive control (MPC) algorithm for the interleaved dc-dc bidirectional converter with coupled inductors for Photovoltaic (PV) applications. An averaged discrete state space model of the converter was developed. The main control objective was to regulate the output voltage to its reference value despite changes in the load and battery voltage. The receding horizon strategy with extrapolation was used to reduce calculation complexity of the prediction. We propose some enhancements in the control signal duty cycle enumeration process, which is a part of the objective function minimization. The results of simulation experiments demonstrated good performance of the proposed control algorithm.

articleTitle: A deep cascade neural network based on extended neo-fuzzy neurons and its adaptive learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: An architecture and learning methods for deep neural networks that increase a number of layers and adjust their synaptic weights in an online mode are proposed in the article. The system's architecture is based on nodes of a special type (extended neo-fuzzy neurons) which possess enhanced approximating properties. A main feature of the proposed network is a learning process for each node that is performed sequentially in an online mode.

articleTitle: Variable-frequency electric drive with a function of compensation for induction motor asymmetry
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Operation of a variable-frequency electric drive with damages in power electric circuit of the motor stator results in asymmetry of the motor phase current charge, increase of heating losses in certain phases, occurrence of variable components of electromagnetic torque and consumed power. Such operation modes significantly influence both motor operation and frequency converter operation, as long operation of a semiconductor energy converter under such conditions results in considerable overheat of certain switches, and later - in complete breakdown. The paper presents results of research of two devised vector-control systems with a function of compensation for motor broken windings influence on the characteristics of the variable-frequency electric drive. The first case deals with a possibility of compensation for electromagnetic torque variable component that causes additional vibrations of the motor. In the second case a possibility of compensation for consumed active power variable component is demonstrated; it results in reduction of heat overload of both separate phases of the motor and semiconductor switches of the frequency converter.

articleTitle: History and perspectives of THz components and circuits using oversize dielectric-lined waveguides
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A set of quasioptical (QO) components was developed for designing the THz radio measuring circuits for plasma diagnostics, radar engineering, spectroscopy, non-destructive testing, biomedicine, education, etc. Components and circuits were built on the basis of oversized dielectric-lined low-loss waveguides with hollow core and included attenuators, phase shifters, polarization-plane rotators etc. The working wave was characterized by the plane phase front, linear polarization, and axially symmetric amplitude distribution. The mode field maximum lies on the waveguide axis and field magnitude smoothly falls toward the waveguide walls. Comparatively to other similar components, the outer metal shell provides protection from environmental impact and increases rigidity. Each component can be joined one to another in one circuit using flanges, pins and clamps.

articleTitle: Expanded calibration of the MEMS inertial sensors
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A new calibration method for Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) of strapdown inertial technology was presented. IMU has been composed of MEMS accelerometers, gyroscopes and a circuit of signal processing. Normally, a rate transfer test and multi-position tests are used for IMU calibration. The new calibration method is based on whole angle rotation or finite rotation. In fact it suggests to turn over IMU around three axes simultaneously. In order to solve the equation of calibration, it is necessary to provide an equality of a rank of basic matrix into degree of basic matrix. Normally MEMS gyroscopes have got g- and g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-drifts. It is proposed a way of finding such drifts. The results of simulated IMU data presented to demonstrate the performance of the new calibration method.

articleTitle: Novel single-stage buck-boost inverter with unfolding circuit
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A novel solution of a single-stage buck-boost inverter with unfolding circuit at the output stage is presented. The inverter has a wide range of input voltage regulation, minimum passive components and a very flexible control structure. It can be applied for renewable energy systems where high power density is required. Our simulation results confirmed all theoretical statements.

articleTitle: Complex reflection coefficient determination via digital spectral analysis of multiprobe reflectometer output signals
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The possibility of complex reflection coefficient value estimation via discrete Fourier transform of output signals of equidistant probes in multiprobe measuring line is considered. This approach provides linear problem and explanation of known previous results. The general features of this approach and the holography with colliding beams are under discussion. The influence of noise on accuracy of complex reflection coefficient estimation is analyzed.

articleTitle: Automatized computer system for evaluation of rust using modified single-scale retinex
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problem for assessing the degree of rusting is considered. The rust percentage on the coatings can be objectively computed using digital image processing methods. As illumination can significantly influence on the result of segmentation the basic model of single scale retinex is analyzed for luminosity equalization. It is shown that this model is based on the usage of local contrast inversion. The parametric model of luminosity equalization is built. It is based on logarithmic transformation of inversion of weighted contrast. After this preliminary rust image processing the global thresholding is applied. Percentage of segmented rusted area is used for designating the degree of rusting.

articleTitle: Adaptive filtration of parameters of the UAV movement on data from its location calculated on the basis the time difference of arrival method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: On the basis of a mathematical apparatus of the mixed Markov processes for discrete time optimum and quasioptimum adaptive algorithms of filtration of parameters of the UAV movement on data from its location calculated on the basis the time difference of arrival method are synthesized. Devices that they are realized, are multichannel and belongs to the class of devices with feedback between channels. The analysis of a quasioptimum adaptive algorithm is made by means of statistical modeling.

articleTitle: A method for synchronous dataflow retiming
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A method of retiming the spatial synchronous dataflow graph (SDF) is proposed, which is based on the SDF representation in the multidimensional space. The dimensions of this space are the spatial coordinate of the processing unit, coordinate of the operator firing and operator type. At the first stage of the datapath synthesis, the operator nodes are placed in the space according to a set of rules providing the minimum hardware volume and minimum clock period. At the second stage of the synthesis, this spatial SDF is balanced and optimized providing the minimum register and multiplexer number in the resulting datapath. The resulting spatial SDF is described by VHDL language and is modeled and compiled using CAD tools.

articleTitle: Statistic metrics for evaluation of binary classifiers without ground-truth
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper, we present a number of statistically grounded performance evaluation metrics capable of evaluating binary classifiers in absence of annotated Ground Truth. These metrics are generic and can be applied to any type of classifier but are experimentally validated on binarization algorithms. We applied the statistically grounded metrics and compared them with metrics based on annotated data. Our approach has statistically significant better than random results in classifiers selection, and our evaluation metrics requiring no Ground Truth have high correlation with traditional metrics. We conducted experiments on the images from the DIBCO binarization contests between 2009 and 2013.

articleTitle: Assessment of pipeline network leakage influence on dynamic characteristics of the pump complex
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: It is demonstrated that pump complexes pipeline networks are characterized by a high degree of breakdown rate because of leakages accompanied by complicated wave processes in the hydrosystem. It is found out that pipeline network wave processes depend on localization place and amount of the leakage, hydronetwork structural parameters as well as the properties of the transported liquid. Leakage influence on technological, electromechanical and energy characteristics of the pump complex is determined. It is stated that to identify the leakage it is expedient to use a signal of hydraulic power, whose frequency analysis makes it possible to obtain a wider spectrum of diagnostic signs of non-stationary condition. It is shown that leakage is accompanied by growth of hydraulic power variable component, in particular, its sine component.

articleTitle: Electrotechnical control and current protection system of the high-voltage pulse-current generator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The current monitoring objectives in the discharge circuit of the pulse-current generator for the pulse-discharge technologies were analyzed. The designed control and current protection system of the 4-channel pulse-current generator performs the real time reaction on the appearance of the idle discharges and the short-circuit mode, stores the numbers of the nominal and idle discharges, and, during the short-circuit mode, blocks and turns off the generator. The system simulation and testing of the experimental prototype were successfully performed.

articleTitle: Kinect based system for student engagement monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Keeping students attentive during lectures may significantly improve learning outcomes. Traditional methods of attention estimation cannot offer a real-time feedback to the teacher. We present a technical concept of student attention monitoring during a lecture. The system utilizes a set of cameras providing tracking of the behavior of individual students in the classroom. The monitoring system is based on visual cues, which possibly detects a decline in students' engagement. The system is planned to help teacher respond to attention drops during the lecture thus improving overall learning outcomes.

articleTitle: Shaped nanoantennas on cylindrical and planar substrate
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: As a rule nanoantennas represent shaped nanodipoles placed either in some media or mounted on the planar dielectric substrate. In this paper we propose some designs which are new for nanoantennas, namely, shaped silver nanodipoles like a traditional nanodipole and a shaped slotted torus nanodipole are placed on the glass circular cylindrical substrate. In these designs nanodipoles are mounted on the cylindrical substrates in different ways that we call E-polar as well as H-polar cases. Also in the paper the slotted torus nanodipole is discussed on the planer substrate. We present results of the theoretical study in which we turn attention to the plasmon resonant frequencies, their field structures and input impedance behavior versus frequency. The principal and high modes open-circuit resonances are discussed. Results were obtained using FEM solver in the CST Studio software.

articleTitle: Evolution of stability of synchronization parameters in packet networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: There are main parameters of synchronization signals stability and methods for their measurement in packet networks in the article. We consider an evolutionary way leading to the modification of stability parameters during the transition to packet networks. Issue the results of measurements on the real network.

articleTitle: Impact of linear regulator, installed in the electric grid of energy supply company, on power losses
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Possibility of decreasing energy losses, caused by mutual influence of nonuniform electric grids, operating in parallel, by means of introduction of phase shift transformer in previously determined optimal branch of the grid and usage of its optimal angle for current operation mode is proved on the example of 230/6 kV electric gride. It is also proved that the application of phase shift transformer with optimal angle in the branch, determined by maximum non-uniformity index enables to reduce both power losses in the grids of lower voltage and total power losses in power transmission systems and distribution grids, preventing the flow of transient power from higher voltage grids into the grids of lower voltage.

articleTitle: Heat loss minimization field control of motionless induction motors in pause of intermittent duty
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper presents a novel field control algorithm for induction motor (IM) in the field oriented vector control (FOC) system in pause of intermittent duty using Euler's optimization equation for the copper losses minimization. The comparison of optimal demagnetization process with this one that is achieved by breaking the stator circuit is carried out. The analytical expressions for the losses values as functions of magnetization or demagnetization times with the hyperbolic, exponential and linear rotor flux change algorithms are derived. By analyzing the expressions obtained for the extremum, transient times are found, which ensure a minimum of losses in copper. It is shown, that motor demagnetization and following its magnetization during the intermittent duty pauses increases the efficiency of vector control.

articleTitle: Efficient simulation of wind generation systems using voltage-behind-reactance model of doubly-fed induction generators and average-value model of switching converters
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Wind power generation has an essential role in renewable energy development. Doubly-fed induction generators (DFIGs) are widely used in wind energy systems due to their variable speed operation capability. In DFIG-based wind generation systems, the machine's stator is directly connected to the ac grid, while the rotor is controlled with a back-to-back converter. For practical simulation of large-scale wind farms, it is essential to have numerically efficient models for the electrical machines and converters. In this paper, a voltage-behind-reactance (VBR) model is presented for DFIGs. The new model achieves a direct interface of the machine's stator with external ac network, and can use the detailed and/or average-value-models (AVMs) of switching converters on the rotor. The proposed VBR model is demonstrated to achieve the best numerical efficiency and accuracy in all combinations of machine-converter models and outperforms the conventional qd model of DFIGs that typically requires interfacing snubber.

articleTitle: An exploratory model of the hardware-software unit for adaptive digital time signal processing against the background of masking clutters
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper describes an exploratory model (prototype) of the hardware-software unit for adaptive digital time processing of signals embedded in masking clutters. The prototype is built using the digital-signal-processor-based adaptive lattice filter. Results of pre-testing are given.

articleTitle: Quad-band matching network design with real frequency technique employing frequency transformation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this study, a piecewise frequency transformation is presented for quad-band (QB) matching network design. The real frequency direct computational technique RFDCT is incorporated with the generated QB transformation. The proposed approach employs three sequential application of low-pass (LP) to band pass (BP) transformation. Transformation parameters are derived by using a direct LP to QB mapping scheme. RFDCT is used to find the optimum element values of a pre-defined transformer free matching network topology within a nonlinear iteration routine which incorporates the QB transformation. For assigned quad pass-bands, the parameters of QB transformation are also optimized to improve transducer power gain (TPG) of the matching network. A quad-band matching network design example is given to illustrate application of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Determine the boundary value of the concentration of gases dissolved in oil of method minimum risk
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article describes the method of determining the boundary concentrations of dissolved gases in oil, providing at least possible economic damage in the event of erroneous decisions. A comparative analysis of the average risk of the values, which are accompanied by the use of the boundary values of gas concentration, regulated well-known international and national standards.

articleTitle: Efficiency evaluation of electroacoustic sensors for auscultation devices of human body life-activity sounds
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article discusses experimental studies results of acoustic characteristics of three sensors: a contact microphone, accelerometer and stethoscopic microphone sensor. These sensors are designed for use in an electronic stethoscope, which allow to evaluate their acoustic efficiency. It was found that the most effective electro-acoustic sensors are contact microphone and accelerometer. The analysis of the main factors determining the efficiency of the studied sensors was carried.

articleTitle: Multiple reflections from non-periodic Bragg layered structures
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The parameters of pulses reflected from non-periodic Bragg layered structures have been investigated. The specific structures such as asymmetric resonators with periodic Bragg reflectors and structures with chirp variation of the thickness of the “period” have been examined. The numerical investigations have been made both in Bragg band and outside it. The frequency characteristics of the structures have been interpolated by the methods of Prony and continued fractions.

articleTitle: Modeling and investigating the behavior of complex socio-economic systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In the paper the problems of modeling and investigating the behavior of complex socio-economic systems are considered. Authors are deeply concerned about decision-making support issues in the case of evaluation for such complex socio-economic systems. To solve these problems, the totality of the development goals of the object and the priorities of these goals are determined, then the indicators are formed in to multifactor model that allows to assess the dynamics of achieving the objectives and the impact of the adoption of certain management decisions. This research includes the development of new approaches for system coherence of data of various nature, methods of aggregation and verification for data, adaptation of data mining methods for applied interdisciplinary research.

articleTitle: A double fourier series implementation for modulated signal with the arbitrary modulation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Restrictions of double Fourier series implementation for modulated signal representation are considered. A general extension of double Fourier series for modulated signal with arbitrary modulation is proposed. The Fourier series premodulation with width and position functions is considered. The premodulation function properties are analyzed. Double Fourier series implementation on a program modulated signal example is shown.

articleTitle: Exploring the vector space model for online courses
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this article, we investigate the role of recommender systems and their potential in the educational system. The key idea is to describe the information aggregation capabilities of a recommender system to find the best way tutoring. The recommender system presented in this article is based on building a vector space model for massive open online courses (MOOCs). We show that the resulting model can be used to effectively query semantically related courses as well as search for clusters and linear transitions between them.

articleTitle: Automation of intelligent sensor injection inlet in polymer moldings by using vector controlled electric drive
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The automation system algorithm, which allows matching the work of the injection device and the masticator for the intelligent sensors inletting in specialized polymer moldings, was developed. Therefore, the above-mentioned system allows the sensors to be injected directly into the cross-section set stepped coordinates of the product. The vector controlled asynchronous electric drive was selected in order to provide required motion modes. The results of experimental studies confirmed the possibility of the system algorithm practical implementation.

articleTitle: Evaluation of low-and high-voltage GaN transistors in soft-switching DC-DC converter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper focuses on performance benchmarking of Gallium Nitride based transistors operating in a soft-switching DC-DC converter. Two prototype converters rated for 300 W were assembled to compare the performance of Si MOSFETs and GaN HEMTs: 100 V devices were used in the current-fed input side and 650 V ones in the output voltage-fed side. The experimental results confirm superior switching performance, negligible reverse recovery charge and low driving losses of GaN devices, especially advantageous at switching frequencies above 100 kHz.

articleTitle: Improvement of data transmission reliability in wireless sensor networks on the basis of residue number system correcting codes using the special module system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper presents an enhanced special module system for correcting codes based on Residue Number System. The research of algorithms hardware and time complexity for error detection and correction has been conducted on the basis of the Residue Number System correcting codes, using the proposed module system. Implementation of error detection and correction devices on the Field-Programmable Gate Array, using a special module system, provides reduction of hardware costs approximately by 26% with the projection method, that is about 6.5 thousand logic elements, and approximately by 10% with the method of the syndrome calculation.

articleTitle: The microwave imaging method for express diagnostic of cancer
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The rapid growth in the number of cancer patients in the last decade has become a real challenge for modern medicine. At first, it is due to the fact that in most instances the effective treatment is possible only in the early stages of the disease. Modern medical diagnostic methods which allow to carry out earlier and pre-clinical diagnostic is usually invasive, costly, not always safe for the patient, and cannot be widely used for screening. Therefore, currently, the creation of new inexpensive and safe methods of early non-invasive diagnosis of cancer is an important task. The report describes the main issues and challenges related to development of microwave imaging systems of biological objects. The original hardware-software system for the study of biological objects is created. The system has frequency range from 137.5 to 4400 MHz and the sensitivity of 55 dB. The visualization of the object under study is performed according to the scattering measurements in the near field region.

articleTitle: Using multidifferential transducer for pulsed eddy current object inspection
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this article is considered of experimental results of using the multidifferential type of a transducer at two excitation mode - pulsed and harmonic. The research was carried out on the plates-type samples made of steel and aluminium alloy which had artificial defects like crack. It has been described the analysis procedure signals informative parameters from multidifferential type transducer. The signal amplitude, decrement and frequency of natural oscillations have been used as informative parameters of the transducer signal at the pulsed mode of excitation. The research of multidifferential type of the transducer at harmonic excitation mode was carried out on the frequency which was equivalent to natural oscillations frequency at the pulsed mode of excitation. It is given the experimental results of evaluation of the electric conductivity and cracks depth influence to signal informative parameters. The general character of dependencies of the signal amplitude, decrement and frequency at pulsed mode excitation of the transducer from crack depth in testing samples are found. Also, sensitivities of the signals informative parameters of multidifferential type transducer at both excitation modes to crack depth variation have been defined.

articleTitle: Vibration transmission in electronic packages having structurally complex design
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper demonstrates that vibration sustained by electronic packages while their operation or tests cannot be characterized by vibration measured either on their supporting base or on the shaker transmitting this vibration. The theoretical model of the oscillating system representing electronic unit installed on the support subjected to vibration is described. Vibration transmission from the shaker to the tested electronic unit is explained as the complex problem to solve. The experimental measurement of vibration conducted inside of tested electronic units verified significant difference in amplitude of vibrations transmitted inside the units and external vibrations that units are exposed to.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional modeling of electromagnetic and tempreture fields in the inductor of channel-tipe furnace for copper heating
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A three-dimensional mathematical modeling and an analysis of the magnetic and temperature fields distribution in a lined inductor of melting-holding furnace for copper melting have been made. The analysis has been made based on the following objects properties: a complex geometry of the system; a non-linear conductivity dependence on the copper temperature; ferromagnetic properties of the iron magnetic core and a presence of water cooling of busbar and inductor housing, considering the temperature and mass transfer of the liquid. A long process of inductor primary starting which is a continuous heating and melting of the copper template during 18 hours was considered. The local areas of the highest temperatures and temperature gradients in the inductor lining were determined. Their time changes were defined to optimize the heating process and to analyze the resource of melting-holding furnace.

articleTitle: The ratio of standard ear tympanogram and the area of the eardrum
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The ratio of the tympanogram width (gradient) at a frequency of 226 Hz, which is standard for impedancemetry of the human middle ear, flexibility, the area of the eardrum and the angle that characterizes its obliquity, was theoretically and experimentally confirmed. It is determined that the magnitude of the outer ear canal volume coincides with an equivalent volume of the women's and children's middle ear at the resonance frequency.

Author Keywords: resonant frequencies of the middle ear
formula for the middle ear norm parameter

articleTitle: A formal proof of properties of a presentation system using Isabelle
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper we present a correctness proof for Infosoft e-Detailing 1.0 presentation software using Isabelle proof assistant. This work illustrates a method of proving correctness of parallel software using proof assistants. Here we concentrate on the state-based approach for proving a safety property. We also give a comparison of this approach with the correctness proof method that was applied to this system in the previous works. The task, rationale, the details of the proof and comparative analysis of approaches are described in this paper.

articleTitle: Apparent power decompositions of three-phase power supply system to develop control algorithms of shunt active filter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: For the model of three-phase four-wire power supply system in an unbalanced non-sinusoidal periodic mode, which takes into account the energy losses in the active resistance of a power cable, the physical meaning of the presented formula for apparent power definition is analyzed. The conditions of its equivalence with the formulas given in the IEEE and European standards are defined. Based on the decompositions of the apparent power of three-phase four-wire power system on quadratic components, the development of shunt active filter control algorithms is considered and the comparative assessment of energy losses in the application of these algorithms is fulfilled.

articleTitle: Analysis of observed-based control systems with unmeasured disturbance
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Transfer functions and equivalent transformed structures of observed-based linear time-invariant control systems with the deterministic unmeasured disturbance have been found. They allow to simplify analysis of these systems. To determine the transfer functions used in formulas for the cell matrix.

articleTitle: Simulation of liquid hydrometeors' scattering power distribution in multi-polarization radar
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper, we have considered and studied potentials of the multi-polarization radar system. The system allows receiving signal at different polarization angles including principle polarization and orthogonal to principle polarization. The computer model of reflections from vibrating and deformed liquid hydrometeors was developed. The simulation results demonstrated the benefits of the system including better signal-to-noise ratio, possibility to estimate the degree of reflected signal depolarization caused by atmospheric dynamic phenomena, registration of vibrating component by selection of receiving antenna polarization angle.

articleTitle: EM exposure study on an inhomogeneous child model considering hand effect
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper presents the human EM exposure simulation study considering the presence of a hand, holding the handset. The inhomogeneous child model was used to simulate thermal response of head tissues exposed to RF energy at 900 MHz, 1900 MHz and 3700 MHz frequencies. The goal of proposed research is to study how the head and hand (fingers) positions (being in a near field of phone's antenna) can influence on the SAR pick values and temperature rise in the head tissues, caused by absorption of EM field energy. 1mm and 10mm distances have been studied from the handset to the child's head model. Numerical simulations are carried out using finite-difference time domain (FDTD) method. Obtained results are presented and analyzed below.

articleTitle: Method of approximation the magnetizing inductance curves of self-excited induction generators
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper presents a novel method of approximation the magnetizing curve of self-excited induction generators. The main feature of this method is the presence of an additional non-linear region of approximated dependence that is designed to connect the two linear regions corresponding to unsaturated and saturated states of the magnetic system, without the gaps of the function which describes the dependence of magnetizing inductance on magnetizing current. The proposed method provides high accuracy of determination the characteristic of induction generator and allows reaching an adequate presentation of analytical dependencies between the parameters of standalone generating system. The analytical results are confirmed with experiments. The proposed method can be used for the design of new high-performance standalone generating systems with self-excited induction generators with improved generating properties.

articleTitle: Transient radiation of circle with uniform current distribution
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Transient electromagnetic field radiated from the plane disk of uniformly distributed electric current is investigated. The problem is solved with the help of the evolutionary approach. The main purpose of the article is to show the new representation of the analitycal solution in time domain of the problem.

articleTitle: Modeling of water tree growth between micro-inclusions in XLPE cable isolation and its effect on electric field distribution
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A mathematical modeling of processes of water tree grows between water micro-inclusions in cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) insulation of extra-high voltage cable has been made. An effect of tree grows on the electric field disturbance in the dielectric was determined. Trees configuration was set with variable cross-section, which called “string of pearls” form. It were made the calculations and analysis of the electric field enhancement, as well as increase of stressed volumes and current densities in insulation depending on the number of tree conducting branches, which simulate the tree growth over time. The comparison of disturbances caused by as mentioned defects as other water defects was made to determine the configurations, which cause the worst material degradation and thus the most strongly reduce XLPE resource.

articleTitle: On-board diagnostics of Li-Ion battery packs for electric vehicles using a combination of spectroscopy and identification methods
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: An accurate parameter estimation becomes one of most important goals of modern battery management systems in electrical vehicles and smart grids. Actually, only state of the charge is used to analyse the battery conditions. However, information about internal resistance and capacity as well as open circuit voltage allows optimizing the battery operation mode either while charging or discharging and therefore increase the lifetime of the battery. Hence the battery parameters like capacity or the internal resistance are not constant and are changing due to environmental influences like temperature or cell ageing, the need for online identification methods becomes more and more important. The key idea of the proposed paper lies in the application of impedance spectroscopy methods without injection of an additional current and using the transient signals during operation of an electric vehicle. The accuracy of estimation with three typical dynamic load profiles is analysed. It is shown that the open circuit voltage impacts the results of an impedance spectroscopy in ultra-low frequency range. To compensate this impact and to enhance the estimation accuracy the classical impedance spectroscopy is combined with an open circuit voltage estimation algorithm in time domain. The simulation results as well as experiments with a real battery pack show the correctness of a proposed approach.

articleTitle: Conditional linear random process and random coefficient autoregressive model for EEG analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In the paper a new mathematical model of electroencephalographic (EEG) signal has been justified in the form of conditional linear random process (CLRP). The model has been derived from the biophysical nature of brain electrical activity. Random coefficient autoregressive (RCA) model (as a member of the class of discrete-time CLRP) has been applied for EEG signal processing. Using the special statistical test, RCA model has been shown to be more suitable for given EEG data than the autoregressive one with constant coefficients, especially for heteroscedastic EEG from epileptic patients.

articleTitle: The authentication method in wireless sensor network based on trust model
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Existing wireless sensor network are developing rapidly and soon will occupy a dominant place among the data collection and communication. The remote location of the sensors and automatic operation increases their vulnerability to outside intrusions and attacks. Because of out of constant sensor supply the providing of authentication is quite challenging whereas the best protocols is negotiated sensor capabilities. The method of sensor authentication in the wireless sensor networks, which is based on a model of trust, is proposed.

articleTitle: No-reference metric of generalized contrast for complex images
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problem of no-reference measurement of generalized contrast for complex multi-element images is considered. The histogram-based method for no-reference measuring the generalized contrast of multi-element images is proposed, based on the use of the average value of the summary contrast for all pairs of image elements relative to the value of the adaptation level, at which the contrast accepts a minimum value. The no-reference metric of generalized contrast is also proposed, based on the use of the value of adaptation level, at which the generalized contrast of the current image accepts a minimum value. A comparison of the proposed and known histogram-based metrics of generalized contrast was carried out.

articleTitle: Automated composition of Petri net models for cellular structures
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Cellular networks are significant challenges for high performance data-intensive system designers due to their complexity. Being able to study features and designs before building the actual system is an advantage that a simulation model can offer. This paper presents a Petri net models program generator of communication hexagonal grids of arbitrary size for verification of telecommunication systems protocols with a hexagonal cell. Petri nets parametric description is used for automated composition of cellular grid models. The model, basic parameters are: the cellular grid size, the buffer capacity of the communication device, the number of packets in each device buffer. The basic element of the grid consists of internal buffer with the limited size and six ports, which operate in full duplex mode; the destination ports are chosen in nondeterministic way in the model. A program generator of Petri net models is written in the algorithmic language C. The output format type of generated file is represented as a Tina modeling system graphical format. The technique can be used in a wide range of Petri nets applications, including telecommunications, manufacturing systems and programming.

articleTitle: Sensors element on base of the relief Au-coated GaAs grating
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This work presents research of the sensors element refractive index. Presented sensor element consists of the one-dimensional relief Au-coated GaAs grating. The grating parameters have been optimized to maximize angular sensing signal using RCWA method. High sensitivity due to plasmon polariton resonance was observed under TM polarization. The optimized grating was manufactured using method of photo stimulated etching (GaAs gratings structure) and vacuum deposition method (Au coating).

articleTitle: Transient radiation of system of four noncollinear dipoles
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The transient excitation of four dipoles in a plane that form rhombus is considered. The problem is solved in time domain by vector potential method. The radiated transient field is compared with the field of a single dipole with doubled excitation current and bigger length. It is considered the appearance and behavior of new components of the vector radiated field.

articleTitle: Data mining of relationship in crowdsourcing projects and social activities of citizens
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper considered defining relationships between various the social activity of the population of the region and the quantitative characteristics of its representation in crowdsourcing project OpenStreetMap (OSM). The research of factors that influence to the social activity of the population and creating volunteered geographic information was performed. Assumption about a correlation between social activity of population and OSM data is verified based on constructing spatial data mining models for example of territory of Ukraine. The basic geographical peculiarities of the distribution relationships and the possibility of their use in regional studies were marked.

articleTitle: Picking a human fall detection algorithm for wrist-worn electronic device
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Nation aging raises a problem of elderly health care and this problem will only grow stronger next decades. Preventive and remote care for seniors come to the fore as the solution to lower the number of potential patients in clinics and to reduce the cost of medication in case of accidents by providing first aid in time. Human fall is a source of danger in any age and, especially for older people. It can become a cause of injury itself and it can also be a result of dangerous event in human organism. That's why human fall detection is significant. This paper describes a first phase of research dedicated to developing a fall detection algorithm for a wrist-worn wearable device. Comparison and analysis of existing algorithms and solutions on market is made. Hardware setup for human fall detection is built and tested. Live tests on volunteers are performed to evaluate accuracy of chosen type of algorithm. Also algorithm is tested during daily activity to determine most fall-similar actions, and work out a way to distinguish those from true fall.

articleTitle: A set of instructions for data flow virtual machine
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A set of instructions for data flow virtual machine is researched. An experimental virtual machine for data flow paradigm is presented for demonstration of computational model. Backus-Naur form of input file for data flow virtual machine is described. A definition of data flow processing in virtual machine is proposed. Some simple data flow computation examples are described.

articleTitle: Electric power system simulation for risk assessment of power transformer failure under external short-circuit conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Complex mathematical model, algorithm and software of risk assessment of failure if defected power transformer windings due to external short circuit were proposed, based on the use of fuzzy modeling of technical condition of power transformer windings and probabilistic and statistical modeling of power grid to determine probability characteristics of short circuit currents, which is flowing in the power transformer windings.

articleTitle: Late reverberation reduction and blind reverberation time measurement for automatic speech recognition
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Development of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems robust to late reverberation action is urgent task. It is well known that a late reverberation reduction algorithm used as ASR pre-processor demands prior estimation of reverberation time. Blind reverberation time measurements are less accurate than ones for known room impulse response (RIR) direct measurements. As result, it is naturally expect that ASR accuracy for blind reverberation time estimation will be lower than one for direct estimation technique. Unfortunately, it is difficult find information on the recognition accuracy loss in literature. In this paper, attempt to eliminate this gap is realized, and conditions of minimizing the loss by it reducing to 3-5% are specified.

articleTitle: The neuro-fuzzy controller for handover operation in mobile networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper proposes using a neuro-fuzzy controller in mobile networks for improving the handover process. An architecture of the neuro-fuzzy controller was developed. Linguistic variables, terms and membership functions for input and output values were defined. A rules base was developed. The operation of the neuro-fuzzy controller was simulated and trained.

articleTitle: Model of multicast routing with support of shared explicit reservation of link resources
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper the mathematical model of multicast routing of flows with support shared explicit reservation of link resources is proposed. The proposed model consists of a linear expressions, which are responsible for providing the connectivity of the calculated multicast routes, and also the absence of loops in them. The novelty of the model is the using of conditions of prevention the congestion in communication links due the implementation of the shared explicit reservation, which allows allocating the links resource between multiple flows, but at the same time the list of these flows is strictly defined. The optimization problem of multicast routing of flows with support shared explicit reservation of link resources is formulated as the task of mixed integer linear programming. Using the proposed model allows to use the available link resource more efficient (on average 20-25%) by providing the coherence of solutions of multicast routing problem and organization of shared explicit reservation of link resources.

articleTitle: Automatic histogram-based contrast enhancement for low-contrast images with small-sized objects
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problem of image enhancement for low-contrast images with the small-size objects is considered. The histogram-based method for contrast enhancement of low-contrast images with the small-size objects on the basis of the estimation of parameters of contrast distribution at boundaries of image elements for the various definitions of contrast kernels is proposed. The proposed method is intended for the automatic preprocessing of low-contrast images with complex structure. The researches of the effectiveness for the proposed and the well-known histogram-based methods were conducted using the known no-reference contrast metrics.

articleTitle: Discrete models characteristics of the acoustic emission signal origin forerunners
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Mathematical models of the acoustic emission signal origin forerunners at the level of the atomic interactions, allowing to receive the equation of motion of point masses of the structure of materials which are in a far from equilibrium condition are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Study of phase composition in the technologically modified Mgo-Al2O3 nanoceramics using XRD and XPS mehods
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The phase composition in the technologically-modified MgO-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> nanoceramics sintered at 1200 °C and 400 C for 2 h and 9 h are investigated using X-ray diffraction and high-resolution X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. It is shown that structural perfection of MgO-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> ceramics increases with sintering temperature and their duration, which manifests reducing the content of the additional phases.
