abstract: We propose to use composite permanent magnet and iron insert focusing system for modern compact submm-waveband vacuum electron devices of the clinotron type that has the potential of improving by at least a quarter on the mass of the current in-house design while preserving the required values of guide magnetic field, simplifying the system assembly, and reducing the overall system dimensions.

articleTitle: Space-charge limited current of relativistic charged-particle beam in coaxial drift tube of finite length
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The analytical estimate of space-charge limited (SCL) current of axisymmetric relativistic charged-particle beam in coaxial drift tube bounded in the longitudinal direction is obtained. We compare numerical nonlinear and analytical estimates of the SCL current in the finite drift tube. A simple correspondence between the analytical estimate of the SCL current in unbounded and bounded coaxial drift tubes is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Radiation field of a dipole placed at impedance sphere
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A radiation field of a radially oriented dipole located on a sphere was studied using an electric Green's function for the space outside of an impedance sphere. The directivity of the spherical antenna in wave zone was determined depending upon variations of the sphere diffraction radius and reactive impedance magnitudes.

articleTitle: A simple way to broaden objects search area for tracking methods based on discriminative correlation filters
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We propose a simple way to broaden objects search area for tracking methods based on discriminative correlation filter using two window functions of different bandwidth. Testing at the VOT-2016 Challenge confirmed that this approach provided higher robustness and accuracy of tracking, comparing to standard realizations, where only one window function was used. We created a software implementation of tracking system based on the proposed approach and estimated its performance. The proposed software realization for PC platform and modern ARM platforms can track objects in real-time.

articleTitle: NMR properties of Fenna-Matthews-Olson light harvesting complex: Photosynthesis and its biomedical applications
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this article we study the structural properties of the bacteriochlorophyll taken from the Fenna-Matthews-Olson (FMO) light harvesting complex found in the green sulphur bacteria. This study is motivated by a range of applications of photosynthetic complexes, including their increasing role in biomedicine, where our better understanding of their properties become critical. Specifically, in our current study we present the nulcear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectrum of the bacteriochlorophyll that is directly taken from the FMO complex, as well as the spectrum for this system for its optimized geometry. We use density functional theory to calculate the optimized geometry and the NMR spectra of the bacteriochlorophyll. From our calculations we found that the chemical shift values are slightly lower for the optimized geometry of the bacteriochlorophyll than the values obtained for the unoptimized bacteriochlorophyll. The differences observed between these two spectra are due to the fact that the unoptimized structure of the bacteriochlorophyll possess the influence of the protein environment of FMO complex.

articleTitle: Tunable disk patch antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The fundamental characteristics of tunable microstrip disk patch antenna with operated shorting-vias were studied. Theoretical simulations and experiments showed the significant advantages of such antenna. This antenna provides a good matching in relatively wide band and it allows choosing the type of pattern characteristic.

articleTitle: The application of power-law distribution for capacitor banks selection in the electrical sypply systems and networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper describes the application of regularities of power-law distribution in form of its modification - technical cenosis approach which allows to provide the efficient functioning of capacitor banks in systems of electrical technology and to improve the efficiency of these systems. The application of the additional technical cenosis criterion allows the obtaining of the practical solutions in capacitor banks selection for efficiency improvement and stabilization of voltage profile in the radial distribution networks.

articleTitle: Fuzzy model of transfer criteria for network distribution to 20 kV voltage
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper presents the fuzzy mathematical model of transfer criteria of distribution network to 20 kV voltage by analyzing the parameters of the distribution network. The model used for the rapid analysis of priority network licensees to determine the order of their funding. As the basis of the synthesized criteria model was accepted a linguistic definition of priority transfer distribution network to 20 kV voltage by mathematical reproduction by fuzzy logic controller considerations of expert based on base knowledge represented by linguistic rules.

Author Keywords: model of transfer criteria for network distribution to 20 kV voltage

articleTitle: A decision support system for evaluation of decision alternatives on basis of a network criteria model
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A decision support system is developing for solving practical problems of decision alternatives' evaluation on the basis of a network criteria model. The main input data in the DSS are expert pairwise comparison judgments of the model's elements. Different mathematical methods are used in the DSS to evaluate the model, calculate local and aggregated weights of model's elements. It helps to increase reliability of resulting solutions. Sensitivity analysis tools implemented in the DSS allows to perform a sensitivity analysis of resulting weights and rankings of decision alternatives, find the most sensitive elements, which require more precise expert estimation.

articleTitle: Mode selective properties of the multi-ring diaphragms in a dielectric waveguide
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Cylindrical vector beams have a great number of applications, including electron acceleration, material proces-sing, high-resolution metrology, microellipsometry and spectro-scopy. Methods and approaches for forming beams with complex polarization structure are practically absent in the terahertz range. Using Body of Revolution Finite Difference in Time Domain (BOR FDTD) method the reflection and transmission coefficients of the waveguide modes with different symmetry and polarization are obtained numerically for the diffraction mirror in the form of the azimuthal periodic multi-ring small-scale and large-scale diaphragms positioned within a circular hollow dielectric waveguide. Obtained results can find their application in development of new intracavity methods of forming of the radiation with spatially inhomogeneous polarization in terahertz range lasers.

articleTitle: Method of determining the strain value from the output signal of the fiber optical sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The dependence of the Bragg wavelength shift from the strain and the ambient temperature at the point of sensor remains is analyzed. Algorithms and software for the implementation of the mathematical model of the fiber optical sensor based on Bragg gratings is developed. The level of relative strain of the sensor output signal on the fiber optical sensor is determined.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of the semiconductor converter with twelve-zone regulation of output voltage
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The analysis of electromagnetic processes in an electric circuit with the semiconductor converter is presented in the paper. The mathematical model for the analysis of electromagnetic processes in the semiconductor converter with power width regulation of the output voltage has been created. The problem of using the method of multiple parameter modulating function has been solved in the research work.

articleTitle: Properties of CdTe films prepared by DC magnetron sputtering
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In order to create thin-film solar cells based on cadmium sulfide and telluride experimental studies of the process of cadmium telluride magnetron sputtering with direct current, and the impact of a magnetron sputtering mode on CdTe films crystalline structure were carried out. CdTe films for the base layers of thin film solar cells was obtained on flexible polyimide substrates by magnetron sputtering with direct current for the first time. It has found that increasing the magnetron discharge current up to 80 mA leads to increase in coherent scattering regions what is due to an increase in the thickness of the cadmium telluride films of the hexagonal modification having a columnar structure. A further increase in the discharge current leads to a decrease in the size of coherent scattering regions what caused by the thermodynamical output formation of low-angle boundaries. It has shown experimentally that the “chloride” processing of the obtained cadmium telluride layer leads to the transformation of the metastable hexagonal modification cadmium telluride in a stable cubic modification. At the same time, due to the eutectic recrystallization, increase in the sizes of coherent scattering regions by a decade and the microstrain level reduction in 1.5 times are observed.

Author Keywords: flexible solar cells based on cadmium sulfide and telluride
method of magnetron sputtering with direct current

articleTitle: Complementary coded waveforms sets in marine radar application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Sets of waveform and mismatched filter pairs are used. On the contrary with Golays matched waveform filter pair the mismatched waveform filter pair does exist for all N (number pulses in waveform). Using corresponding shapes of filter good Doppler tolerance may be provided. This property together with a good range side-lobs level suppression makes it's attractable for use in marine radar.

articleTitle: Ukrainian cropland through decades: 1990–2016
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper we present the results of trend analysis of cropland change since 1990 to 2016 in Ukraine. The analysis is performed on the basis of cross-comparison of official statistical data from State Service of Statistics of Ukraine and crop type maps developed by our team for the territory of Ukraine for three decades, namely 1990s, 2000s and 2010s and 2016. Crop type maps built with use of multi-temporal Landsat-4/5/7 and Sentinel-1/2 satellites imagery and an ensemble of neural networks, in particular multilayer perceptrons (MLPs). This analysis shows significant cropland areas decrease over the territory of Ukraine.

articleTitle: Influence of parallelepiped surface defects on Terahertz and optical ellipsometry measurements
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper is devoted to experimental study of the influence of surface defects such as localized defects specific for polycrystalline materials, subjected to ion sputtering, on optical ellipsometry data. The study was performed using ferrite substrates with ferrite parallelepipeds of different size located in the center of the sample. A quasioptical multiangle terahertz ellipsometer that operates at 2.2 mm (0.14 THz) wavelength was used. Such a large wavelength makes it relatively easy to create structures with known geometric parameters on the surface under study. It is shown that ellipsometry is not sensitive to localized defects in the form of a parallelepiped if its size is comparable or smaller then the wavelength.

articleTitle: Basic ideas of quantum mechanics of open systems in application to electron and optic processes
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Kinetics of a quantum system immersed in an equilibrium medium and completely described by its statistical operator is investigated. The case of a separable interaction is considered in details. A concept of the effective Hamilton operator of the system is discussed. The kinetic equation for a point particle in a spatially uniform external field placed in a medium of point particles is obtained in terms of the Wigner distribution function of a particle. The kinetic equation is applicable for strong spatially inhomogeneous (localized) states of the particle and strong external field. The elaborated theory is used also for a system of two-level emitters and photons interacting with an equilibrium phonon medium. The kinetic equation for the statistical operator of the system of the emitters and photons that describes the effect of emitter motion on the super radiance phenomenon is obtained.

articleTitle: Robust synthesis of two-degree-of-freedom system for stabilization of ground vehicle instrumentation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper deals with features of robust two-degree-of-freedom system assigned for stabilization of information and measuring systems operated on the ground vehicles in difficult conditions accompanied by influence of the parametric and coordinate disturbances. The optimization criterion and state space model of the augmented plant are derived. The design procedure of robust system for stabilization of equipment assigned for operation on the ground vehicles is considered. The two-degree-of-freedom controller based on the robust synthesis is obtained. The results of the synthesized system simulation and their analysis are given.

articleTitle: Wideband polarizing quasioprtical terahertz phase shifter
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The phase shifter is one of the basic elements of radio measurements systems. The polarization phase shifters with half-wave differential phase section rotating in the field of circular polarized wave rotating between two quarter-wave sections are widely used in waveguide and quasi-optical microwave circuits. The widebandedness of such phase shifters is determined by the widebandedness of the differential phase sections. The broadband differential phase sections composed of several birefringent elements with the planes of anisotropy twisted with respect to each other are used to expand the operating frequency range. Theoretical and experimental studies show the efficiency of the use of the differential phase sections in the polarization phase shifters operating in the THz frequency range.

articleTitle: Microwave physics and technologies: History and results of collaboration of teams from Ukraine, Germany and China starting in 2000s
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper gives an overview of the history and statistical data concerning collaborations between a Ukrainian research team and teams from Germany and China, respectively. The main results obtained within the framework of research and development collaborations on microwave physics and technologies are described.

articleTitle: Numerical method for processing frequency measuring signals from microelectronic sensors based on transistor structures with negative resistance
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The application of the proposed mathematical tools, that can be used for signal processing self-generating transducers of physical quantities, are considered. Its operating mechanism is based on frequency modulation, when the frequency deviation depends on the intensity of exposure measurement parameter. It is shown that the action for leveling additive errors in the channel the signal generator is highly stable enough to use approximating second order polynomial.

articleTitle: Thin dielectric resonators in microwaves
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: With a purpose of microwave equipment frequency range enlargement, and in order to improve quality factor of frequency-selective devices, thin dielectric resonators (DR) are investigated. The principles of microwave filters and phase shifters designs, based on thin dielectric resonators, are presented. Some new constructions of such devices are elaborated. Results of theoretical and experimental studies of thin DRs are described.

articleTitle: Elemental composition and luminescent characteristics of Zns:Cu powders, obtained by self-propagating high-temperature synthesis using Nacl as a flux
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This work was devoted to ultrafine ZnS:Cu powders obtained by self-propagating high-temperature synthesis (SHS) using NaCl as a flux. Powder particles size and morphology were characterized by scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Elemental composition was measured by local energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS). Photoluminescence (PL) and luminescence excitation (PLE) spectra were studied. The influence of different amount of NaCl as a flux in synthesis of ZnS:Cu on its elemental composition and luminescent characteristics was investigated.

articleTitle: Yevgeny M. Kuleshov, human delta-function in Ukrainian microwave science and technology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper presents a short review of the life and research achievements of remarkable person in the Ukrainian microwave and millimeter-wave science and technology of the XX and XXI centuries, Dr. Yevgeny Mitrofanovich Kuleshov.

articleTitle: Performance prediction in radar image filtering and lossy compression. Part I: Filtering
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper analyzes possibilities and recently proposed methodology of performance prediction for denoising and lossy compression of radar images under assumption that they are corrupted by pure multiplicative noise. Methods based on discrete cosine transform in blocks are considered. Characteristics of the noise (speckle) are assumed a priori known or pre-estimated with high accuracy. They are taken into consideration in setting parameters of denoising techniques (thresholds, parameters of homomorphic transforms) and compression methods such as quantization step. It is shown that simple statistics of DCT coefficients in 8×8 pixel blocks can be used for prediction of improvement (reduction) of peak signal-to-noise ratio. Curves for prediction are obtained by regression into scatter-plots in off-line mode. Applicability of the proposed prediction approaches is confirmed by real-life examples.

articleTitle: Clustering of users in social networks by their activity
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper we present some preliminary experimental results related to searching correlations between users' psychological traits and the properties of their social network graph. We explore simple clustering techniques on standard available data extracted from mainstream social media platforms. Our experiments on approximately 1000 users show that we are capable of identifying 9 groups of users by their activity on social networks.

articleTitle: Lasing thresholds of plasmonic modes of a silver tube nanolaser with active shell and core
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We considered the source-free problem of the H-polarized field in the presence of a circular silver nanotube with inner active core coated with a concentric layer of the same active material. In the analysis, we used mathematically grounded Lasing Eigenvalue Problem, according to which we assumed that at the threshold the natural-mode frequency is real-valued. We looked for it together with the corresponding threshold value of material gain in the active regions. To build characteristic equations for each azimuth index, we used the separation of variables. We found surface plasmon modes of such nanolaser, classified them, and studied the dependences of modal thresholds and wavelengths on the core, tube and shell thicknesses.

articleTitle: Toward development of neural networks with strong anticipation
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Since the introduction of artificial neural networks (ANN) the numerous investigations of concrete systems had been proposed. But further development of the theory and applications of networks follows to the investigations of new examples of dependent of time systems with anticipatory property. New special class of anticipatory systems had been introduced by D, Dubois - namely the system with strong anticipation. So in proposed paper the new examples of neural networks with anticipation had been considered - namely the ANN with strong anticipation. It is proposed the mathematical formulation of models, possible problems of learning rules for connections and examples of behavior of solutions. Multivalued behavior of such solutions is discussed in context of properties of neural networks.

articleTitle: Transport network optimization methods of mobile operators in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This work presented simplified transport network topology of the mobile operator with excretion of Ukraine regional centers. On its basis three-tier network architecture RRS over OTN over DWDM was built, which aims to minimize the total bandwidth for each routing and switching node. The proposed control method of transport network provided by the use of virtual transport switches OTS to create SDN-transport network, which will provide direct control of the backbone mobile operator network.

articleTitle: Discrete models of the electric grid elements, obtained with using the second-order formula of implicit gear method
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A complete description of the electrical network elements models obtained with regard to their longitudinal, transverse and phase-to-phase parameters. Differential equations of transient processes are characterized by a large spread of time constants. The implicit Gear method of the second order is applied to the numerical solution of such “stiff” equations. The implicit Gear method is applied to three-phase networks, i.e. not for two-pole elements, but for three-phase multipoles. The elimination of internal nodes in discrete models makes it possible to present model elements in a unified form, to reduce the dimensionality of the equivalent circuit the entire electrical network. In the work discrete mathematical models of the electric network elements are obtained: power transmission lines, power two-winding transformers. The reliability of the results obtained by the developed mathematical model is confirmed by the conducted experiments testing on real objects.

articleTitle: An approach to triangulate area bounded simple polygons
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This In the paper we propose optimal algorithm for area triangulation between m arbitrary polygons on the plane with time complexity O(NlogN). The efficiency of the algorithm is achieved by reducing the problem to the triangulation of simple polygons with holes. A simple polygon with holes we triangulate using the monotone chains method. It allows getting a simple implementation.

articleTitle: Spectral quasi-optical terahertz ellipsometer
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The goal of the present paper is connected with spectral quasi-optical ellipsometer (SQOTE) creation, based on the hollow dielectric beamguide and beamguide components as a quasi-optical transmission line. Ultra-broadband quasi-optical transmittance line provides operation of the ellipsometer within 0.17-0.225 THz (1.2-1.8 mm) frequency range. The set of elements of the transmittance line, which require matching with the generator, was determined. The principle and details of SQOTE measurements were described and its accuracy was estimated. Experimental testing of the ellipsometer was carried out by comparing dielectric constants of a set of materials measured by the setup with reference data and with the results of independent reflectometry measurements.

articleTitle: Systematization of problems of automated control in cognitive maps' impulse processes for complex systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In the report new problems of control of cognitive maps' (CM) impulse processes are systemized for complex systems of different nature. Possibilities of control of these processes in dynamic mode by means of control design based on automated control theory methods are analysed. Control design algorithms for impulse processes which consider special aspects of complex systems CM's are discussed.

articleTitle: Pipe weld X-ray image distortion removal
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Approach for geometrical and blur distortion compensation of objects on X-ray images is developed. The purpose of the approach consists of minimization of distortions caused by the projective nature of X-ray imaging on results of weld inspection in nondestructive testing. Prior knowledge on analyzed object is exploited to simplify complexity of image rectification problem. Proposed approach is used for X-ray images of pipe welds. Experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: Information systems development for open data analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The use of open data is important for digital transformation of society. It effects on economics, industry, education etc. Therefore the development of information systems for open data analysis becomes more necessary. This paper presents an approach to develop open data based information systems. The approach consists of data processing algorithm and basic unit structure. Furthermore, the paper provides the technical solutions which can be used to realize proposed structure. The approach has been used on experimental research of financial transaction open data.

articleTitle: The technical inspection of device for integrated evaluation of the antioxidant activity of foods
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This article deals with the technical testing of device for integrated evaluation of the antioxidant activity of foods. Results of technical testing are given. The major attention is paid to testing of hardware implementation of device.

articleTitle: Study of the ATI SAR target signature for non-linear airborne tracks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper shows the results of simulation and analysis of the ATI SAR signatures of the stationary and moving targets for linear and non-linear airborne tracks. Estimated azimuthal displacement of the moving target is found for some simulated and experimental RAW data. It is proposed to use a backprojection algorithm with the estimated squint angle as the digital filter for the filtering of a stationary and slow-moving targets.

articleTitle: Development of a simulation tool for optimal design of a mobile photoplethysmography sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: A simulation tool for optimizing a mobile photoplethysmography (PPG) sensor is developed and introduced. At its core there is the Monte Carlo technique simulating photons propagation through turbid tissues. In the simulation workbench various simulation procedures that include different boundary conditions, wavelengths, incident angles, power and type of the sources as well as its optical beam characteristics (collimated Gaussian beam, focused Gaussian beam and collimated launch) are realized. We expect that employment of the simulated layout of the PPG sensor and it's optical structure may help increase number of detected photons that convey tissue optical properties.

articleTitle: Scalar potential calculations for relativistic charged-particle beam in unbounded coaxial drift tube
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We receive the first order analytical expression for the scalar potential transversal distribution of finite width uniform density axisymmetric relativistic charged-particle beam propagating in the unbounded in the longitudinal direction coaxial drift tube in the strong guide magnetic field, which exhibits nonlinear dependence on the beam injection current. Ranges of the injection current values that show non-uniqueness of the solutions to the nonlinear ordinary differential equation describing the transverse distribution of the scalar potential in unbounded coaxial drift tube are also found numerically.

articleTitle: Energy efficient and simple control of stand-alone combine heat-power generation small wind turbine
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This article presents an autonomous wind turbine, in which take place the generation and accumulation of two types of energy - electricity and heat, which are needed in the home of an individual consumer. Such combine heat-power wind turbine except of functionality extensions has simple and effective system for optimal control. Efficient generation of electricity is carrying out by means of a passive mode at medium to high wind speeds. Automatic optimal control of the heat generation process can perform at all wind speeds by periodically connecting the thermoelectric heaters to the armature winding of the generator. Computer simulation shows the efficiency of the simple control system.

articleTitle: Analysis of quantization noises in multistage signal processing systems: A case study of digital down converters (DDC)
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper describes a new method of analyzing the effects of the quantization noise in cascaded multirate filter structure based on a calculation of Power Spectral Density (PSD) of quantization noise at the output of the digital system with the consideration of the filtering action of all its multiple cascades and multiple decimations. The results include the mathematical expression used for finding the PSD quantization noise at the output of each cascade of the filter chain. These expressions provide means for the choice of internal codes bit capacity that satisfy to desirable performance of the system.

articleTitle: The use of ART-2 neural network for processing information signals of non-destructive testing
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Describes the universal approach to the intellectual automated system development of digital signal processing for acoustic testing devices with free vibrations method and the usage of artificial neural networks. The system solves the problem of defects recognition and classification, and enhances performance testing in comparison with traditional instruments.

articleTitle: Nonuniform absorbing coating as an effective way to reduce radar visibility of an object with the surface formed by flat conductive plates
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Evaluation of opportunities to reduce radar visibility of objects which surface is formed by combination of flat conductive plates by applying a cover, which electromagnetic wave absorbing effect by its pass is determined by previously selected edge surface weighting grid function. Resulted backward scatter diagram of rectangular plates without cover, with even coverage and homogeneous coating of the same amount, thickness of which is applied based on standard weighting functions. Obtained results show that reducing radar visibility of objects is achieved by reducing a level of main lobe, and significant reduction of backward scatter diagram side lobes in all angles of observation. It is shown that advantage of this method before applying even coating is the possibility of selecting an optimal solution features of various problems, such as energy maximizing of the main lobe at a maximum speed of side lobes energy decreasing, minimum main lobe expansion at a fixed maximum side lobes level, minimizing absorbing coverage amount, minimization side lobes level at a fixed absorbing coating amount.

articleTitle: Improving of IDA-PBC systems by forming additional regulatory actions on directly uncontrollable system loops
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper raises the problem of regulatory limitation in port-controlled Hamiltonian energy-shaping control system (PCH ESCS). For this solution, it is proposed to use regulatory actions on directly uncontrollable loops, which can be formed during synthesis and always are discarded due to impossible implementation, by transmitting these actions through controllable loops in two different ways: first - by rebuilding closed-loop PCH to suitable form, second - by correcting reference signal. In order to check existing solutions and verify feasibility and effectiveness of proposed approaches they were used to synthesize ESCSs for a simple direct current drive, which were further investigated. Obtained results confirmed that both approaches allow outmatching existing solutions and having their advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: Excitation of whispering gallery modes in a high double-layer disc shielded dielectric resonator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The investigation of shielded dielectric resonators on the base of the dielectric resonant structures with high Q-factor and improved spectral characteristics is the aim of this work. The thesis is article to the solving of the effective excitation of the whispering gallery modes in the shielded quasioptic dielectric resonators by the using of a planar waveguide.

articleTitle: Experimental detection of wave chaos in quasioptical cavity resonator with random bulk inhomogeneities
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The wave chaos signs in quasi-optical cavity resonator with random bulk inhomogeneities has been studied experimentally. It is shown that inhomogeneities in the resonator lead to intermode scattering which results in the shift and broadening of spectral lines. The shift and the broadening of each spectral line are strongly depended upon the frequency distance between the nearest-neighbor spectral lines. We have found out that inhomogeneities result in the resonator spectrum stochastization. The active self-excited system based on the inhomogeneous quasi-optical millimeter wave cavity resonator with a Gunn diode was examined as well. We have detected that random inhomogeneous in our resonator can rarefy its spectrum.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of volume optical interconnection reconfiguration utilizing acousto-optic beam forming
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The mathematical model of volume optical interconnection reconfiguration by acousto-optical beam forming approach is proposed in the paper. The restrictions of proposed model were considered as well as results of simulations of interconnections' patterns were presented.

articleTitle: Modeling the non-homogeneous media with specific refraction coefficient
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The new approach for creating the non-homogeneous media with specific refraction coefficient is proposed. The electromagnetic wave scattering problem is solved at condition that the embedded in the initial homogeneous media bodies are small and described by their surface impedance. The numerical results confirm the possibility to create the media with the new refraction coefficient that changes in the range of 30%-40% in comparison with its initial value.

articleTitle: Wound rotor induction machine with an excitation from capacitor energy caused by slip power
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The idea of an excitation of wound rotor induction machine from capacitor energy caused by slip power is presented. The main feature of the idea is that excitation of the machine is performed from rotor side without energy source in rotor circuit. The energy of the electric field in rotor can be stored in capacitor and used for compensation of the stator reaction and for operation with given value of power factor. Principle of operation of electromechanical system (EMS) realizing this idea has been explained theoretically and validated by physical experiment. Boundaries of the limitation area with the energy of the electric field stored in capacitor in rotor circuit lower than the energy of the magnetic field required for control tasks depicted above, have been determined theoretically. However, it was shown on the simulation results and explained that presented EMS can operate in wide range of modes if slip and loading don't fall under determined level, and if system parameters are selected correctly.

articleTitle: Nonlinear spin wave excitation at the interface between two ferromagnets with broken spatial inversion symmetry
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this paper we consider the system of two ferromagnets semi-infinite media with interface in which spatial inversion symmetry is broken. We obtain the boundary conditions for interface of this model materials. The possibility of nonlinear spin wave formation at transmission of a spin wave through the boundary of two ferromagnets with spatial inversion broken symmetry was shown.

articleTitle: Effective inductor systems for pulsed accelerators and actuators
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The simulation of the pulsed magnetic field dynamics in the cross section of anisotropic core with a closed magnetic path is performed at linear rise of magnetizing force in time. The program QuickField v.6.2 (professional) has been used as the tool of research. On the base of results of simulation there is shown that slow diffusion of magnetic field into external sheets of package leads to the distortion of magnetic flux over cross section from the linear dependence on time. Evolution of magnetic induction distribution in the process of non-linear diffusion is shown by graphs. The correction of magnetizing force pulse form is proposed for the improving of linear rise of flux.

articleTitle: Variations of the effective height of the lower ionosphere by results of analysis of tweek-atmospherics. Preliminary results
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Generated by fulminant discharges and propagating in the Earth-ionosphere waveguide tweek-atmospherics are often used to tracking the heights variations of the lower ionosphere over geographically large areas. Recorded by our sensors in the city of Kharkiv tweeks were analyzed, and preliminary results are presented in this paper. A sufficiently accurate lightning centers coordinates determination is shown, and lower boundary ionosphere heights variation was about 2 km, with a maximum of 1–2 hours of local time.

articleTitle: X-band resonator for studying the various axially symmetric inhomogeneities in the frequency band
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The problem related to the choice of an adequate microwave resonator for measuring the dielectric constant of substances with the high permittivity and losses is considered. Numerical modeling and experimental investigations of a rectangular X-band resonator with the axially symmetric inhomogeneities, such as a dielectric cylinder and the dielectric capillary filled with the solutions, which have the different dielectric permittivity, are carried out. Both optimal sample sizes depending on their dielectric permittivity and the geometric parameters of dielectric capillaries for studying the various liquids are determined.

articleTitle: Using microservices in educational applications of IT-company
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Educational systems of IT-companies typically provide a network space in which students and teachers can come together for teaching and learning. Using the microservice architecture offers advantages in application development.

articleTitle: Modeling the deterministic chaos microelectronic oscillator based on the bipolar transistor structure with negative resistance
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper considers a new electric diagram of the microelectronic self-excited oscillator based on the bipolar transistor structure with negative resistance. The oscillator operates in oscillatory and relaxation modes. Chaotic mode of the self-excited oscillator was provided by installing additional components into a basic circuit. Results of the deterministic chaos microelectronic oscillator simulation were obtained. Simulation was performed with standard PSPICE models of radio components. Time and frequency characteristics of the oscillations were obtained.

articleTitle: Providing fixed level of electric energy supply quality in conditions of renovation of power distribution electrical networks with renewable energy sources
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Transition to electric heating, connection of renewable sources of energy are the main reasons, stipulating the necessity of reconstruction or modernization of the existing distribution electric grids. The research suggests the selection technique of optimal supply circuit of electric energy consumers from various sources on the base of the analysis of the given expenses and integral index of functioning quality, that enables to take into account the electric energy quality and the reliability of the electric grid.

articleTitle: Generation properties of nonlinear layered objects and eigen-modes of the linearized problems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: An important task of nonlinear electrodynamics is to understand the nonlinear behavior in the induced polarization and to analyze and to control its impact on the propagation of electromagnetic fields in the matter. The paper presents a mathematical model as well as computational results for the excitation of cubically polarizable layered dielectric by wave packets.

articleTitle: Generalized formalization of risks for dynamic risk management problems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper introduces complex unified approach to formalize and define risks of different kind. It based on a detailed definition of risk factors, assessing possible risk situations and reducing general system problem of risk management to the optimization problem of minimizing the costs for reducing the risk degree, level and aftermath mitigation. The concept is focused on solving dynamic problems in changing conditions.

articleTitle: Ternary reversible/quantum latches
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Ternary reversible latches on the basis of one- and two-qutrit permutative Muthukrishnan-Stroud (MS) gates were synthesized for the first time. Such gates can be physically implemented on the basis of liquid ion-trap quantum technology. The use of adaptive genetic algorithm allowed designing the circuits of latches that are optimal with respect to quantum cost, number of gates, and delay time. Comparisons of synthesized circuits with known results of other authors were carried out.

articleTitle: Speed sensorless direct field oriented control of induction generator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The paper presents a novel field oriented speed sensorless vector control algorithm for induction generators. The proposed controller exploits the concept of direct field orientation and provides asymptotic DC-link voltage regulations when DC-load current is constant or slowly varying. An output-feedback linearizing technique is employed for the voltage controller design. The proposed control algorithm has well defined tuning procedure and guarantees system performance stabilization for all physical operation modes. Results of simulation study shows that voltage regulation performances, achieved with proposed sensorless controller, are of the same level as in the system with speed measurement. Controller is suitable for standalone and grid connected (via suitable inverter) renewable and traditional generation systems.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of a linear actuator for contactless positioning systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: This paper presents the semi-analytical calculation of a propulsion force, generated between a moving permanent magnet and a rectangular air-core coil. The derivation of the proposed equations is based on the magnetic surface charge model. Compared to time-consuming numerical programs, this method combines high accuracy with a very short calculation time. Moreover, a Halbach array and a single permanent magnet are compared in terms of levitation force generation. The results obtained by the analytical equations and the verification by finite element method (FEM) will be presented in this paper as well.

articleTitle: Detection of glyphosate in deionised water using machine learning techniques with microwave spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Glyphosate is a commonly used herbicide which carries some risks of ecotoxicity and has been shown to be harmful to human beings with high levels of exposure. Existing methods of glyphosate detection often struggle to achieve the level of sensitivity required to meet regulatory requirements without the use of complicated analytical methods with multiple intermediary steps. We propose the use of microwave spectroscopy to determine the concentration of glyphosate in aqueous solutions, using machine learning methodology to identify a minimum feature set for our model. The resulting model had a limit of detection of roughly 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>mg/L, fitted values were significantly (Pearson's R = 0.8833, P<;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-29</sup>) correlated with the target glyphosate concentration.

articleTitle: Synthesis of circularly polarized radiation by inphase crossed impedance wire dipoles with screen
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The 3D vector problem of diffraction of the field of the system of synphasely excited crossed half-wave wire dipoles of similar geometrical sizes, but with different surface impedances, and located parallel to the perfectly conducting rectangular screen, has been solved. On the base of the uniform geometric diffraction theory method with using the asymptotical expression for a current of an impedance wire dipole located over a perfectly conducting plane the fast active algorithm has been developed for computations. The surface impedances of inphase wire dipoles which ensure formation of the circularly polarized wave in the normal direction to the screen depending on the dipole's removal from the screen and on the screen dimensions have been found.

articleTitle: Diffraction by two semi-infinite gratings placed in the same plane
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Diffraction by two semi-infinite gratings placed in the same plane is considered. The method of singular integral equations is used. The current on the strips is represented as the current on the semi-infinite periodic gratings and correction current. The convergence of the method is discussed and far-field patterns are represented.

articleTitle: Neuro-musculoskeletal simulator of human rhythmic movements
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: In this article, a new neuro-musculoskeletal simulator of human rhythmic movements is presented. It is based on a specific model of central pattern generator able to generate variable rhythmic signals for controlling a biological joint by changing its intrinsic parameters from upper controller. The CPG consists of three layers and four types of neurons and controls human leg hip joint. Its output signals generated by motoneurons are applied to excitation inputs of two modelled muscles of the human hip. The variation CPG speed showed short transition process with stabilization on two leg motions in swing phase. Phase diagram of hip joint angle showed stable movement as stabilization on single trajectory. Further work is aimed on development of stable human gait by applying CPG for each leg muscle.

articleTitle: Application of concave diffraction grating for increasing data capacity of polymer optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Polymer optical fibers are the best transmission media for a short-range data transmission systems. To overcome the limits of transmission capacity of a one polymer optical fiber, the wavelength-division-multiplexing technology is successfully used. The demultiplexer with a concave diffraction grating has simplest construction and allows simultaneous transmission of several independent signals over a one fiber thus increasing the full data capacity of a one polymer optical fiber.

articleTitle: Lasing thresholds of plasmon and grating modes of coated silver nanowire gratings
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: We study the electromagnetic field in the presence of a freestanding periodic grating of nanowires made of silver and covered with dielectric shells. In the H-wave scattering problem, reflection and transmission coefficients for such grating demonstrate a cocktail of various types of resonances including plasmon-mode and grating-mode ones. In the Lasing Eigenvalue Problem, where the shells material possess the gain characterized by the negative imaginary part of refractive index purposed to compensate absorption, we determine the wavelengths and the threshold values of gain of these modes.

articleTitle: The investigation of wave process during propagation of plate voltage pulse on three-phase performance cable line
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: The article describes the wave processes in a three-phase cabling system of single-phase performance. The mathematical models for the study of lightning and switching overvoltages have been developed. The dependence of wave velocity and attenuation rates in the phase-to-phase and zero frequency channels on frequency has been researched. The spread of the plate pulse has also been analysed for in the case of a power line short-circuit at the site of cable line coupling. The attenuation rate of waves during their run on the cable line has been evaluated.

articleTitle: Ontology-supported enterprise architecture analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE First Ukraine Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (UKRCON)
abstract: Today, processing integrated information within and between enterprises is increasingly becoming more and more critical, and so is the implementation and evaluation of an Enterprise Architecture (EA). The review of literature on EA evaluation shows several issues. However, the evaluation of EAs has not attracted sufficient attention, and thus, this research area has not been explored thoroughly yet. We believe that in order to ensure consistency, interoperability and computational inferences among EAs, a complete and holistic approach, rather than monolithic, should be developed. Therefore, in this study, we propose an ontology-supported process model for the evaluation of EAs, and present the implementation details. The main contributions of the present study are the improvements realized in the expressiveness, extensibility, and computable power of EAs, and their evaluation techniques. Although the proposed model requires gathering empirical evidences and investigating applications in concrete cases, the first implications of the proposed model indicates its validity and feasibility, and, hence, the initial results are promising for continuing future studies.
